notes: Lane 261110b (scenegraph LD2g). Hooked. sg_floor_color_grid_build_cells: 1500 cases per x87 precision (3000), grids from LD2a's generator with a third of the links unlit, the tile box the whole grid a quarter of the time and otherwise each bound anywhere in it (the minimum past the maximum included); the world is tests/sg_floor_color_world.h's CellWorld (partitions' 43 and 50 with catalog ids 0x1d, 0x11d, 1-6 and an unmapped 0x77; entries' slot 38; level ids around the 16-bit zero test; 0x7e37e0 standing in, null or a pointer with a zero low half), answers varying between calls. Mutants: 29, 27 killed (all by this test, all but one, the kind byte's reset, also by the Rebuild test): the catalog id's full-dword compare at 0x409c15, the 16-bit level id, the whole-pointer wall test, every mask, the half samples, the level set insert, the clear, the prune loop with only direction 1 or none. Two equivalent: the prune loop (0x40a5b0-0x40a5cb, PruneCorner 0x40a790 for directions 1, 3, 5, 7 per sub-cell) without direction 7, or with only 1 and 7. After the link pass (to 0x40a586) a diagonal link is held at both ends or neither, PruneCorner decides on the orthogonal links only (which it never clears) and clears both ends, so each diagonal is pruned the same from either end and one direction of each opposite pair (1/5, 3/7) is enough.
